identityWitness.intervention: one actor carrier property via Proxy for one controller call
identityWitness.stop: after one World tick; no full-play verdict

definitions.catchIdentity: Native catch event and stats.receiver; intended target kept distinct.
definitions.contact: First positive solver body/strike impulse or grasp force after possession; end-of-step boundary, not exact onset.
definitions.graspForce: End-of-step resultant, not force averaged over 0.05 s; armImpulse is separately measured.
definitions.censor: Native timeout is unfinished. Identity intervention stops after one tick and supplies no full-play outcomes.
definitions.lab: Specific native 22-body calls, 2 rosters per panel; no league frequency or NFL dominance claim.
definitions.handbook: Attached guidance/historical evidence, not new measured results.
